# Liquid Glass Health-Tech

Skin ID: `liquid-glass`

Public name: Liquid Glass Health-Tech

Mood: modern health-tech, luminous, clear, polished.

Best-fit niches: metabolic, diabetes lifestyle, nutrition, fitness, progress-oriented coaching.

Visual metaphor: a frosted-glass wellness technology interface.

Structure:
- Hero: layered glass shell with media capsule and floating detail modules.
- Background: CSS aurora/mesh with static mesh fallback.
- Cards: translucent frosted glass with glow borders.
- CTA: luminous aqua glass treatment.
- Navbar: frosted capsule nav.
- Sticky CTA: frosted bottom CTA pill.
- Bonus: digital product tiles inside glass modules.
- FAQ: glass accordion panels.
- Media: cutout or framed photo inside glass capsule.
- Motion: glass shimmer and soft lift, reduced to static fallback when needed.
- Mobile: lower blur, lower opacity, stacked panels.

Difference from default: glass interface, aurora field, translucent card system, glass FAQ, and digital product bonuses.

Must not change: CTA href, Google Form behavior, legal/support links, analytics, bonus service names, FAQ data, inspect slot keys.
